Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Cummy
Description:
Pair with someone over tells, then right-click them to layer cum onto a body part. Layers stack on top of their own current skin (Bibo body), are published through Penumbra so sync plugins show them to everyone, and stay until cleaned or dried off.
Requires Penumbra. 18+ content.
Punchline: Cum layering system for your paired partners.
Changelog:
- Cummy now uses a single mod in Penumbra instead of two. The old "Cummy Layers" mod is removed automatically, and its Proteus options now live inside the Cummy mod. Your layers carry over, nothing to do.
- The Cummy mod is now named after your character, as Cummy [Name Surname @ World], and follows whoever is logged in.
